courses.note: Elective: the major requires no AI course. The course site calls it CPSC 370; the renumbered 4-digit code CPSC 3700 is inferred from Yale's renumbering pattern and is not confirmed in the catalog text. The syllabus has a 'Policy on Working Together' (plagiarism, no group work) that does not mention AI tools.

notes: Yale renumbered its courses to four digits (CPSC 201 is now 2010, 223 is 2230, 365 is 3650, 490 is 4900). The major's core is taken from the catalog page, which lists CPSC 2010, discrete math, 2230, systems, 3650 or 3660, and the senior project.
